scope: Full physical characteristic divisor identification on every original real H-minus-one potential, with actual algebraic multiplicities of the unchanged original H1/H-minus-one operator.
proof_route: Construct the exact bounded complex-linear rotation S(a,b)=(a+i*b,a-i*b) and its inverse. S intertwines both the full domain inclusion and the fixed actual Dirac/Miura companion operators.
Prove no associated eigenvectors for every real-type Dirac potential at finite Banach exponents. Actual algebraic multiplicity therefore equals geometric multiplicity.
Use the full-domain Miura companion/Hill eigenspace equivalence and real Hill semisimplicity to identify actual physical Hill multiplicity at z^2 with actual fixed Dirac multiplicity at nonzero z.

Prove real shifted Miura lifts for every real unit-period H-minus-one potential by conjugation covariance, contraction-ball uniqueness and the verified complex chart. The positive shift can be arbitrarily large and avoids zero square-root energy at any prescribed complex lambda.

Identify unit-period doubled Miura coefficients with the entire original period-two distribution, retaining 2*pi*n versus pi*k normalization. Translate the full physical operator, every root level, full root space and algebraic multiplicity by the same constant.
Extend the literal Miura-image and constant energy-shift identities for the full rough trace by verified density and joint continuity. Evenness gives exact square descent.

For a chosen energy lambda, represent q+c^2=Miura(u) with u real and choose z^2=lambda+c^2 nonzero. The local square-minus-c^2 map has derivative2*z nonzero. Transport analytic order and invoke the verified canonical Dirac product order theorem. The result is the actual full-domain physical algebraic multiplicity, at every lambda.

Transfer to OriginalHminusOnePotential using the exact entire-distribution realization inverse and original reality. Equality of the full characteristic divisors is equivalent to membership in originalIsospectralSet.
qualifications: The physical multiplicity/order theorem is proved for all REAL unit-period H-minus-one potentials. Zero-set matching from the prior milestone remains valid for all complex potentials; a complex-potential algebraic divisor theorem is not claimed.
The original article wrapper retains the entire real mean-zero physically period-one H-minus-one domain. No endpoint membership or preexisting inverse spectral bound is assumed.
Zero energy and multiple roots are included by choosing a suitable shift separately for each energy. No nonzero-energy hypothesis is placed on the final theorem.
Only actual full-domain operator algebraic multiplicities are used. Equality of zero sets or an unrelated NLS Birkhoff map is not substituted for the operator comparison.
The Dirac semisimplicity theorem works at every finite Banach exponent>=1; the actual Hill/Dirac comparison uses p=2.

Original finite-p inverse spectral regularity, uniform isospectral bounds, original Dirichlet comparison, and KdV Birkhoff/physical-flow constructions remain unproved. Every main theorem remains unproved.
